messages: Priya K: Dropping a new direction for the model catalog compare. Instead of the dense table we tried earlier, this mock uses a card-first layout with an optional compact 'List' toggle. Cards show model name, pinned version affordance, and a small primary badge for Latency (p95). Screenshot: https://redwood.design/mockups/catalog/cards_v3.png :eyes: Oliver M: Visually the cards read better, but I'm worried about vertical scrolling. For orgs with hundreds of models, a card stack could be painful. Can we support a compact grid (2-3 columns) and a persistent 'List' toggle so power users switch back to table mode? Maya L: Yes to Oliver. Also current mock collapses the filter shelf when you switch views. We must persist filters across view toggles so users don't lose context. Sam (frontend): Implementation note: card DOM density will increase initial paint cost. We can virtualize the list to keep perf, but that complicates keyboard focus and screen reader ordering. Virtualization + accessible focus management is doable but will require careful testing. Alex R (a11y): A couple of accessibility points: the performance badge colors (green/amber) are low contrast on small text — fail 4.5:1 for some combos. The pin/version control lacks an accessible toggle state. Use `aria-pressed` on the pin button and expose a visible sr-only textual state for screen readers. Priya K: Good call. My thinking: surface only the strongest metric on the badge (Latency p95 with ms unit) to reduce clutter and improve contrast. Other metrics (cost, throughput) would live in the hover tooltip or the expanded compare view. That should help scanning. Maya L: UX idea: clicking "Compare" on two models shouldn't navigate away. Instead open a contextual flyout anchored to the card/row so you keep list context and can quickly compare several pairs. Sam (frontend): Flyout works. We need clear keyboard behavior: set focus to the first control in the flyout, trap focus while open, ESC closes and returns focus to the initiating compare button. If the flyout is modal, mark it `aria-modal="true"`. Also virtualized lists + flyouts require mapping DOM nodes while items enter/leave viewport. Alex R (a11y): Pin button example suggestion: ``` ``` When toggled, change `aria-pressed` to true and update the sr-only to `Pinned version v2`. Also ensure badges use `role="status"` or an `aria-live` region if metrics update asynchronously. Oliver M: Copy tweak: make badge copy explicit: `Latency (p95): 42 ms` rather than `p95: 42`. Helps scanability and reduces ambiguity about units. Priya K: I'll update mocks to show `Latency (p95): 42 ms` as the compact badge text and move cost/throughput into a tooltip. Also will add a compact grid option in the view toggle. DesignBot: Decision logged — Persist filter shelf across view toggles; default to table view for lists with >50 models; card/grid as opt-in; primary badge = Latency (p95) with units; pin button to use `aria-pressed` with sr-only state updates; compare opens in contextual flyout. Owner: Priya. ETA: next Wed. Sam (frontend): I'll prototype virtualization and accessible flyout behaviors once Priya posts updated frames. Will tag eng-runtime for perf signoff once prototype is available. Maya L: Also propose a subtle crossfade on view toggle to reduce layout jump. Provide reduced-motion variant. Alex R (a11y): Final checklist before design handoff: 1) badge contrast meets 4.5:1 for normal text or increase size; 2) pin has aria-pressed and sr-only updates; 3) flyout has correct focus management and `aria-modal` if blocking; 4) live updates use `role=status` or `aria-live`. Priya K: Thanks everyone — I'll upload updated frames + a Loom walkthrough of the flyout flow and behavior notes. :thumbsup:
